---

Sun Data Analytics is a research and analytics site for publishing datasets, reproducible materials, technical notes, and concise reports.

The site is designed to keep the work readable: clear titles, documented data, simple navigation, and enough structure to expand without becoming heavy.

For questions or collaboration, contact [jonathonsun03@gmail.com](mailto:jonathonsun03@gmail.com).
